description: This source file defines the internal class AzureQueueAdapterReceiver, which implements the IQueueAdapterReceiver interface. It manages receiving, processing, and deleting messages from an Azure Storage Queue within the Orleans streaming infrastructure, including queue initialization, message retrieval, and cleanup after delivery.

classes.name: AzureQueueAdapterReceiver
classes.description: Implements message receiving for Azure Storage Queues in the Orleans streaming framework, supporting initialization, message fetching, and acknowledgment/deletion of processed messages.

classes.name: PendingDelivery
classes.description: Internal class used to track pending messages awaiting confirmation of delivery and deletion.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate an AzureQueueAdapterReceiver with provided configuration and dependencies.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the queue, preparing it for message reception.

methods.name: Shutdown
methods.description: Gracefully shuts down the receiver, waiting for outstanding operations to complete and preventing further queue access.

methods.name: GetQueueMessagesAsync
methods.description: Fetches a batch of messages from Azure Queue, converts them into IBatchContainer objects, and tracks pending deliveries.

methods.name: MessagesDeliveredAsync
methods.description: Confirms delivery of messages, finalizes pending deliveries, and deletes the corresponding messages from the Azure Queue.
